panels.title: AI Spend in Range & Fleet Overview

panels.description: LLM spend over the dashboard's time range. A call through the gateway comes from the gateway's spend counter `litellm_spend_metric_total`, which Prometheus scrapes each 15 s and which counts every caller of the gateway. A call that did not go through the gateway comes from devops-cli's `devops_cli_ai_spend_usd_total{provider!="gateway"}` (#4724). The direct part is approximate, and low for sparse series: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing. Delta points from one process can arrive out of order, and totals then come out low (#792).
panels.title: Cloud Spend in Range

panels.description: The hosted spend that local models saved in the time range of the dashboard. The tokens come from the gateway's own counters `litellm_input_tokens_metric_total` (prompt) and `litellm_output_tokens_metric_total` (completion) of the deployments that an in-cluster Ollama serves: `api_provider` `ollama_chat` for chat and `ollama` for embeddings. A hosted call does not count, whatever label a client gives its own token series (#5867, #5914). Each token has the reference price that the dashboard constant reference_price_usd_per_token holds for its operation and type: the hosted price of `qwen3.8:27b` and of `qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b`, which the spend reports of the Service also use (#4241).
panels.title: Local Cloud Savings in Range

targets.expr: sum(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (api_provider) (increase(litellm_input_tokens_metric_total{api_provider=~"ollama_chat|ollama"}[$__range])), "type", "prompt", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (api_provider) (increase(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total{api_provider=~"ollama_chat|ollama"}[$__range])), "type", "completion", "", ""), "operation", "chat", "api_provider", "ollama_chat"), "operation", "embeddings", "api_provider", "ollama") * on (operation, type) group_left () (${reference_price_usd_per_token:raw})) or vector(0)

panels.description: Model calls over the dashboard's time range, from every caller. A call through the gateway is counted once, from the gateway's own series: its chat and embedding requests that got a reply (status 2xx), whoever sent them. devops-cli's own series add only its calls that did not go through the gateway. Replies the response cache answered are not model calls, and Response Cache Hit Share shows them; Gateway Attempts by Status shows the attempts that failed (#1668). Approximate, and low for sparse series: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing. Delta points from one process can arrive out of order, and totals then come out low (#792).
panels.title: AI Requests in Range

targets.expr: (sum(increase(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total{route=~"/v1/(chat/completions|embeddings)", status_code=~"2.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(devops_cli_ai_requests_total{provider!="gateway", cached="false"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.description: Prompt and completion tokens of model calls over the dashboard's time range, from every caller. Tokens of a call through the gateway come from the gateway's own series, whoever sent the call; devops-cli's own series add only the tokens of its calls that did not go through the gateway, without the cache's replies and without reasoning tokens, which the completion tokens hold (#1668). Approximate, and low for sparse series: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing. Delta points from one process can arrive out of order, and totals then come out low (#792).
panels.title: Tokens Processed in Range

targets.expr: (sum(increase(litellm_total_tokens_metric_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(devops_cli_ai_tokens_total{provider!="gateway", server!="cache", type!="reasoning"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Spend: USD per hour
panels.description: The LLM spend in each hour. Each bar is the hour before its time (Min interval 1h), and the bars of a range add up to Cloud Spend in Range. A call through the gateway comes from the gateway's spend counter `litellm_spend_metric_total`, which Prometheus scrapes each 15 s and which counts every caller of the gateway. A call that did not go through the gateway comes from devops-cli's `devops_cli_ai_spend_usd_total{provider!="gateway"}` (#4724). The direct part is approximate: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, and delta points from one process can arrive out of order (#792), so a count can come out low.

The LLM spend in each hour, by hosted provider and model, such as openrouter, anthropic and gemini. Each bar is the hour before its time (Min interval 1h), and the bars of one hour stack to the bar of Spend: USD per hour. A call through the gateway comes from the gateway's spend counter `litellm_spend_metric_total`, by its `api_provider` and deployment model. A call that did not go through the gateway comes from devops-cli's `devops_cli_ai_spend_usd_total{provider!="gateway"}`, by provider and model (#4724, #5914). A model with no spend in an hour has no bar, so a local model shows no bar. The direct part is approximate: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, and delta points from one process can arrive out of order (#792), so a count can come out low.

A hosted call does not count, whatever label a client gives its own token series (#5867, #5914). Each token has the reference price that the dashboard constant reference_price_usd_per_token holds for its operation and type: the hosted price of `qwen3.8:27b` and of `qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b`, which the spend reports of the Service also use (#4241).

targets.expr: sum(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (api_provider) (increase(litellm_input_tokens_metric_total{api_provider=~"ollama_chat|ollama"}[$__interval])), "type", "prompt", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (api_provider) (increase(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total{api_provider=~"ollama_chat|ollama"}[$__interval])), "type", "completion", "", ""), "operation", "chat", "api_provider", "ollama_chat"), "operation", "embeddings", "api_provider", "ollama") * on (operation, type) group_left () (${reference_price_usd_per_token:raw}))

panels.description: The local savings in each hour, by backend server: one bar for each Kubernetes service of an in-cluster Ollama, such as ollama-48gib-fast and ollama-64gib-standard. Each bar is the hour before its time (Min interval 1h), and the bars of one hour stack to the bar of Local savings: USD per hour. The query joins the tokens of each deployment (`model_id`) to the service name in the `api_base` of `litellm_deployment_total_requests_total`. LiteLLM gives an embedding deployment no `api_base`, so its model (`litellm_model_name`) names its bar (`qwen3-embedding:0.6b`), and that bar holds all embedding backends. A backend with no savings in an hour has no bar. The tokens come from the gateway's own counters `litellm_input_tokens_metric_total` (prompt) and `litellm_output_tokens_metric_total` (completion) of the deployments that an in-cluster Ollama serves: `api_provider` `ollama_chat` for chat and `ollama` for embeddings. A hosted call does not count, whatever label a client gives its own token series (#5867, #5914). Each token has the reference price that the dashboard constant reference_price_usd_per_token holds for its operation and type: the hosted price of `qwen3.8:27b` and of `qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b`, which the spend reports of the Service also use (#4241).
panels.title: Local savings by backend server: USD per hour

targets.expr: sum by (backend) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (api_provider, model_id) (increase(litellm_input_tokens_metric_total{api_provider=~"ollama_chat|ollama"}[$__interval])), "type", "prompt", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (api_provider, model_id) (increase(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total{api_provider=~"ollama_chat|ollama"}[$__interval])), "type", "completion", "", ""), "operation", "chat", "api_provider", "ollama_chat"), "operation", "embeddings", "api_provider", "ollama") * on (operation, type) group_left () (${reference_price_usd_per_token:raw}) * on (model_id) group_left (backend) (group by (model_id, backend) (label_replace(increase(litellm_deployment_total_requests_total{api_provider=~"ollama_chat|ollama", model_id!="", api_base!=""}[$__interval]), "backend", "$1", "api_base", "https?://([^.:/]+).*")) or on (model_id) group by (model_id, backend) (label_replace(increase(litellm_deployment_total_requests_total{api_provider=~"ollama_chat|ollama", model_id!=""}[$__interval]), "backend", "$1", "litellm_model_name", "(.+)")))) > 0

panels.description: LLM calls and embedding requests per second by operation and model, replies the response cache answered included.
panels.title: Request Rate by Model

panels.description: Share of the last hour's LLM calls the response cache answered, embedding requests left out; an hour with calls and no cache answers shows 0. Approximate: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing, and delta points from one process can arrive out of order (#792). The counts lost can fall on either side of the ratio, so a share can come out high or low.
panels.title: Response Cache Hit Share

panels.description: The 95th percentile of the time a call to Ollama waited in its process for a slot on one of its nodes, over the last hour, by priority (high, normal or as_available), with the count of calls that asked for a slot on the right axis. A call that timed out counts at the wait it had. Approximate: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing, and delta points from one process can arrive out of order (#792). The counts lost can fall in any bucket, so a quantile can come out high or low.
panels.title: Ollama Slot Wait by Priority (p95)

panels.description: The gateway's chat and embedding requests per hour, by HTTP status, from every caller. A status other than 2xx is a failed attempt: 408 a timeout, 499 a caller that closed the request, 5xx a failure of the gateway or its backend. devops-cli's own series count only the calls that got a reply (#1668).
panels.title: Gateway Attempts by Status

panels.description: The gateway's requests per hour that got a reply, and their tokens on the right axis, by the end user that each request names. devops-cli names its OTel service: devops-cli, devops-cli-job, roadmap-implement, roadmap-service or roadmap-stage. A caller that names no end user, such as Open WebUI or an editor extension, shows as unnamed (#1668).
panels.title: Gateway Requests and Tokens by Caller

panels.description: devops-cli's own spend of its gateway calls (`devops_cli_ai_spend_usd_total{provider="gateway"}`), as a share of the spend that the gateway counts (`litellm_spend_metric_total`) over the dashboard's time range (#4724). A value under 95 % or over 105 % shows red. The rest is gateway spend whose devops-cli telemetry did not arrive, or spend of other callers; Gateway Requests and Tokens by Caller tells the callers apart. Approximate: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing, and delta points from one process can arrive out of order (#792). The spend lost can fall on either side of the ratio, so a share can come out high or low.
panels.title: devops-cli Coverage of Gateway Spend

list.description: The hosted price of one local token in USD, by operation and token type, written as USD per million tokens: the price of `qwen3.8:27b` for chat and of `qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b` for embeddings. These are `ai.reference_model` and `ai.reference_embedding_model` of the Service, with their prices from `price_overrides` in k8s/devops/configmap.example.yaml (#4241), so the dashboard and the spend reports of the Service use the same prices. The savings queries multiply the local tokens by it, and put it in with the raw format, so Grafana does not escape its quotes. tests/prometheus/test_k8s_monitoring_dashboards.py fails when a price differs from the price that the spend reports give the reference models of the template.
list.label: Reference price (USD per token)
list.name: reference_price_usd_per_token
list.query: label_replace(label_replace(vector(0.035 / 1e6), "operation", "chat", "", ""), "type", "prompt", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(1.5 / 1e6), "operation", "chat", "", ""), "type", "completion", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0.01 / 1e6), "operation", "embeddings", "", ""), "type", "prompt", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0 / 1e6), "operation", "embeddings", "", ""), "type", "completion", "", "")
